keyword: is silver a good hedge against inflation
angle: Silver is a volatile but effective long-cycle inflation hedge: it outpaced CPI dramatically in 2025 thanks to a sixth straight supply deficit and surging industrial demand, but its higher volatility versus gold makes it a tactical rather than steady store of value.

stats.claim: Silver posted a year-to-date return of approximately 46% by late October 2025, vastly outpacing CPI inflation projections of roughly 3.1% for the year
The Silver Institute forecasts a sixth consecutive global silver market deficit in 2026, projected at 46.3 million ounces, up from 40.3 Moz in 2025
Industrial and technology applications accounted for approximately 61% of total global silver demand in 2025, up from 53% a decade earlier
Silver industrial demand hit a record 680.5 million ounces in 2024, the fourth consecutive annual record, before easing to 657.4 Moz in 2025
The gold-to-silver ratio sits near 64:1 as of June 2026, below the modern 20-year average of approximately 70:1, after compressing sharply from a 105:1 extreme reached in April 2025
During high-inflation periods exceeding 5% annually, silver historically shows a strong positive correlation with CPI in the 0.7-0.9 range, supporting its role as a tactical inflation hedge
